text: しっぽで　エサを　つるのが　とくい。

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like English '-ing'. エサを　つるのが　とくい = 'it is good at fishing for food'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is the tool used to do the action. しっぽで = 'with its tail'.
